title: ORV / Solo Leveling redesign
question: Match today is the Kylix Tondo Arena. You want a Korean webtoon System HUD world (Omniscient Reader / Solo Leveling). Which surface and flavor should lock the rebuild?

options.label: Match · System Window
options.thesis: Replace Match chrome only: black translucent system panels, blue borders, status-box typography — Draft and fight read as a System window, not a kylix.
options.case: Keeps Lobby/Home as-is; highest fidelity to ORV’s reader-facing System UI.
options.risk: Lobby still feels like a different product until a later pass.

options.label: Match · Hunter Gate
options.thesis: Replace Match chrome only: hunter rank/status HUD, gate-raid atmosphere, level-up spectacle on fight beats.
options.case: Stronger spectacle for the live auto-fight payoff; slightly less ‘message box’ than ORV.
options.risk: Can tip into generic dark gacha HUD if gates aren’t specific.

options.label: Whole app · Fusion HUD
options.thesis: Home, Lobby, and Match share one System/Hunter language — Session join and Draft feel like the same world.
options.case: Matches PRODUCT’s ‘visual UI due for full style rehaul’; one product identity.
options.risk: Larger blast radius; Lobby/auth chrome must stay operable under Clerk.
